metadata.summary: Jitin placed an order for a single everything bagel and a medium hot latte with half-and-half milk and whipped cream at Manhattan Bagel.

messages.text: Hello Jitin, welcome to Manhattan Bagel. It's great to see you again. What would you like to order?
Let me get the options for your bagel choices...
For your bagel, we have a variety of options. You can choose from Plain, Everything, Asiago, Blueberry, California, Cheesy Jalepeño Bacon Roll, Cheesy Hashbrown Roll
Okay. So I want, hot latte, medium size, half and half milk, and, whipped cream, cream as well.
Let me get the options for your hot latte...
You've chosen a hot latte. For the size, we have small, twelve ounces, medium, sixteen ounces, and large, twenty ounces. Which size would you like?

For your medium hot latte, you've also mentioned half-and-half milk and whipped cream. I just want to confirm that you'd like half-and-half as your milk choice, and whipped cream on top, is that correct?
Alright, let me get this order placed for you...
